CURRICULUM CLARITY · 4 MIN READ

Choose support for the course you actually study.

Location is part of your enquiry. Your school syllabus is the other part.

Country and curriculum are different questions.

A student in Dubai may follow a British, American, IB, Pakistan, or another school course. Start with the course listed by your school rather than assume your location determines it.

Check the level and subject.

Include the year group or grade and the subject’s full name. At higher levels, specify any course level or option your school uses.

Bring the school’s materials.

An outline, topic list, or recent assignment helps a tutor understand what you are learning now. It also helps separate an unfamiliar explanation from a genuinely new topic.

Match the immediate need.

Some students need foundations. Others want practice with longer questions or revision of a particular unit. Explain the difficulty using an example where possible.

Confirm before committing.

Ask whether a suitable tutor is available for your exact course and time zone. Share the details again when arranging lessons so the plan begins with the right information.
